result.summary: Reionization ionizing-photon-budget reconciliation at z~10: star-forming galaxies require f_esc=0.190 (+0.164/-0.087) to close the budget (Madau-Dickinson SFRD, log xi_ion=25.5+/-0.15, clumping C=2-5, JWST-SFRD tail), versus indirect-proxy-inferred f_esc=0.080 (+0.147/-0.051) from LzLCS O32/beta calibrations. Median delta(required-inferred)=+0.095 dex-frac (16-84%: -0.051 to +0.263); 76% of the systematic MC shows a shortfall. Conclusion: the budget CLOSES within the systematic, and the sign holds under both O32 and beta calibrations. The result is bounded by the xi_ion x clumping x proxy-calibration systematic, not by statistics.
result.title: The reionization ionizing-photon-budget shortfall for star-forming galaxies is not robust to systematics at z~10 (optimistic systematic corner)
result.provenance: Literature-anchored budget calculation — NO survey catalog data is used. The cosmic SFRD is the Madau & Dickinson (2014) analytic fitting function; xi_ion and the O32/beta f_esc proxy calibrations are adopted published values (LzLCS: Chisholm+22, Flury+22; Simmonds+24). Do NOT state or imply that this study uses JWST, SDSS, or TNG observational/catalog data — it is a systematics reconciliation over published literature values.
result.review:
VERDICT: MINOR

The manuscript presents a careful literature-anchored analysis of the reionization photon budget crisis but has some minor issues that need attention. The top correctness risks include over-reliance on published values for xi_ion and f_esc proxy calibrations, which may introduce uncertainties not fully accounted for in the study. Missing caveats include potential systematic errors or uncertainties in the parameters used from previous studies. The single most important fix is to provide a more detailed discussion of how these uncertainties might impact the results, including sensitivity analyses or error propagation estimates. Overall, the manuscript is well-structured and acknowledges its limitations, but addressing these minor concerns will strengthen its conclusions.
